titulo.estudio: ばかりか と だけでなく
titulo.alumno: Adding a second characteristic with «ばかりか»

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

piezas.titulo: «ばかりか» adds information and usually presents the second item as unexpected or more notable.
texto: «だけでなく…も» also adds items and tends to be more neutral. The parallel form helps you follow which two things are linked.
この みせ は やすい ばかりか、 りょうり も おいしい です。 (This restaurant is not only cheap; the food is good too.)
かのじょ は えいご だけでなく、 フランスご も はなせます。 (She not only speaks English; she can also speak French.)
